High fashion and great wines obviously go together. In fact, some of the top fashion houses own some of the most revered vineyards in the world. Francois Pinault of Gucci and other top marques recently paid hundreds of millions of Euros for the tiny, jewel box of a Burgundy estate called Clos du Tart. Bernard Arnault of LVMH bought last year a majority interest in the California cult wine producer Colgin. Our wine editor James Suckling pulled some of his most recent tasting notes from some of the top names in fashion who also produce world-class wines. Enjoy.
As always, we work with Asia Tatler to inform wine consumers, collectors and trade on what James is tasting, as well as our definitive selections each year. This September, Asia Tatler published James’ list of choice wines from these high fashion houses. Read the full Tatler article in PDF to learn more about these wines!
